issue.title: Align machine-init review policy and Python onboarding expectation

task_type_fields.impact: Full `just check` fails for unrelated feature work once it reaches pytest. The repo has contradictory expectations between Python onboarding coverage and the Rust core policy that owns shared machine-init review behavior, so either the core policy or the Python test contract needs an intentional decision.
task_type_fields.repro: From the sase repo root, run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/dispatch/test_machine_init.py::test_onboarding_assessment_offers_new_unreviewed_candidate -q`. It fails because MachineInitService.assess_onboarding returns offer_enrollment=False with summary "remote machine enrollment review is current" after one reviewed candidate, while the Python test expects a second discovered candidate with a different endpoint and installation pin to trigger an unreviewed-candidate offer. The linked Rust core policy currently has review_assessment_treats_completed_initial_review_as_terminal, so the source-built binding treats a completed initial review as terminal.
